title: Route order
text: Route order (user, 2026-11-24: XML stays, as the last way): (1) copy the parent sequence in Premiere and pick from it (several pieces: `paste_pieces`, never `paste_from` in a loop; one insert: `paste_from`; `arrange`, `keep_words`, `cut_copy`, `duplicate_sequence`); (2) build from the footage only when no sequence holds the material yet; (3) an FCP7 XML only when Premiere can't be driven live, saying in the handover why 1 and 2 failed.
